sentences.en: Gradually, as they walked and ran together, her sadness disappeared.
sentences.zh: 渐渐地，在他们一起散步和奔跑的过程中，她的忧伤消失了。

sentences.en: Sadness seems to last a long time. Happiness is brief.
sentences.zh: 悲伤似乎持续的时间很长。快乐却是短暂的。

sentences.en: Her face reflects disgust and sadness, rather than anger.
sentences.zh: 她脸上流露出的是厌恶与悲哀，而不是愤怒。

senses.zh: 悲哀，忧伤，忧愁，悲哀,令人悲哀或忧伤的事物,愁眉苦脸，心境恶劣，心情恶劣,认真
